title: Three-day guided Sri Lanka tour — Kanisha Malhotra
creator: kanishamalhotraofficial
scope: Compressed multi-region tour promoted in reel

items.details: Private chauffeur pickup from Colombo airport and transfer to Sigiriya.
Village experience with bullock-cart/tractor ride, boat ride and local Sri Lankan food.
Dambulla Golden Temple stop, then hotel check-in in Kandy. Hotel unnamed.
Tea-plantation visit, Nanu Oya–Ella train, then hotel check-in in Ella. Tea estate and hotel unnamed.
Little Adam's Peak and Ravana Falls were included in the tour, but creator says she could not do them because of a foot injury.
